description: PHP class defining a filter field for the 'joinedDate' attribute within a reporting system. Extends a base FilterField class and implements logic to add date-based conditions to a query builder.

classes.name: JoinedDate
classes.description: A filter field class for the 'joinedDate' attribute, allowing filtering employees based on their joining date with operators like less than, greater than, and between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds date-based filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and input values.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias(es) associated with this filter, in this case, 'employee'.
